A screen is **one file**. An analysis of it is **one folder**, kept apart from
the data. This page shows one of each, taken from `example/highmoi/`. Click a
line to see what it holds.

`SPEC.md` has the rules and `RATIONALE.md` the reasons.

```{r}
#| include: false
if (dir.exists("rlib")) .libPaths(c("rlib", .libPaths()))
library(reticulate)
options(width = 100)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
import html
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import h5py
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

SCREEN = Path("example/highmoi/screen.h5mu")
ANALYSIS = Path("example/highmoi/analyses/left_sided")
# every description on this page is read from the specification's own files
screen_spec = json.loads(Path("spec/screen.json").read_text())
table_spec = json.loads(Path("spec/tables.json").read_text())
ROWS = 5
pd.set_option("display.width", 120)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 12)


def text(value) -> str:
    """Plain text as HTML, with `code` spans."""
    return re.sub(r"`([^`]+)`", r"<code>\1</code>", html.escape(str(value)))


def n(count, noun) -> str:
    return f"{count:,} {noun}{'' if count == 1 else 's'}"


def cell(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return f"{value:.4g}"
    if hasattr(value, "__len__") and not isinstance(value, str):
        shown = ", ".join(f"{v:.3g}" for v in list(value)[:4])
        return f"[{shown}{', …' if len(value) > 4 else ''}]"
    return str(value)


def rows(frame: pd.DataFrame, index_name=None) -> str:
    """The first rows of a table."""
    head = frame.head(ROWS)
    if index_name is not None:
        head = head.rename_axis(index_name).reset_index()
    body = head.map(cell).to_html(index=False, border=0, classes="rows", escape=True)
    more = f"<p class='more'>… {n(len(frame) - len(head), 'more row')}</p>" if len(frame) > len(head) else ""
    return body + more


def columns(described: dict, present) -> str:
    """What the specification says about the columns that are present."""
    items = [f"<li><code>{html.escape(c)}</code>: {text(described[c])}</li>" for c in present if c in described]
    return f"<ul class='columns'>{''.join(items)}</ul>" if items else ""


def as_json(value) -> str:
    return f"<pre>{html.escape(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))}</pre>"


def leaf(name, what, size, body) -> str:
    return (f"<li><details><summary><code>{html.escape(name)}</code><span class='what'>{text(what)}</span>"
            f"<span class='size'>{html.escape(size)}</span></summary><div class='body'>{body}</div></details></li>")


def branch(name, what, size, children) -> str:
    return (f"<li><div class='branch'><code>{html.escape(name)}</code><span class='what'>{text(what)}</span>"
            f"<span class='size'>{html.escape(size)}</span></div><ul>{''.join(children)}</ul></li>")


def kilobytes(path) -> str:
    files = [path] if path.is_file() else [f for f in path.rglob("*") if f.is_file()]
    return f"{sum(f.stat().st_size for f in files) / 1024:,.0f} KB"


def screen_tree() -> str:
    says = screen_spec["descriptions"]
    in_every_modality = {c["name"]: c["description"] for c in screen_spec["cell_tables"]["every_modality"]}
    in_grna_table = {c["name"]: c["description"] for c in screen_spec["grna_table"]}
    children = []
    with h5py.File(SCREEN) as f:
        for name in sorted(f["mod"], key=lambda m: m == screen_spec["modalities"]["grna"]):
            grna = name == screen_spec["modalities"]["grna"]
            counts = ad.io.read_elem(f[f"mod/{name}/X"])
            obs, var = ad.io.read_elem(f[f"mod/{name}/obs"]), ad.io.read_elem(f[f"mod/{name}/var"])
            corner = pd.DataFrame(counts[:ROWS, :6].toarray(), index=obs.index[:ROWS], columns=var.index[:6])
            shape = f"{n(counts.shape[0], 'cell')} × {n(counts.shape[1], 'gRNA' if grna else 'feature')}"
            children.append(branch(f"mod/{name}", says["grna_modality" if grna else "modality"], shape, [
                leaf("X", says["counts"], n(counts.nnz, "nonzero count"),
                     "<p class='more'>The first cells and features:</p>" + rows(corner, "cell") + "<p class='more'>…</p>"),
                leaf("obs", says["cell_table"], f"{n(len(obs), 'row')} × {n(obs.shape[1], 'column')}",
                     columns(in_every_modality, obs.columns) + rows(obs, "cell")),
                leaf("var", says["grna_table" if grna else "feature_table"], f"{n(len(var), 'row')} × {n(var.shape[1], 'column')}",
                     (columns(in_grna_table, var.columns) if grna else "") + rows(var, "gRNA" if grna else "feature")),
            ]))
        shared = ad.io.read_elem(f["obs"])
        children.append(leaf("obs", says["shared_cell_table"], f"{n(len(shared), 'row')} × {n(shared.shape[1], 'column')}", rows(shared, "cell")))
        stamp = ad.io.read_elem(f[screen_spec["metadata"]["path"]])
        entries = screen_spec["metadata"]["entries"]
        values = pd.DataFrame([{"entry": k, "value": str(v), "meaning": entries.get(k, {}).get("description", "")} for k, v in stamp.items()])
        children.append(leaf(screen_spec["metadata"]["path"], says["metadata"], f"{len(values)} entries", "".join(
            f"<p class='more'><code>{html.escape(r.entry)}</code> = {html.escape(r.value)}<br>{text(r.meaning)}</p>" for r in values.itertuples())))
    return f"<ul class='tree'>{branch(SCREEN.name, says['file'], kilobytes(SCREEN), children)}</ul>"


def table_leaf(path, what) -> str:
    file = pq.ParquetFile(path)
    frame = file.read().to_pandas()
    body = rows(frame)
    identity = (file.metadata.metadata or {}).get(table_spec["fits"]["identity_key"].encode())
    if identity is not None:
        body = "<p class='more'>How these fits were made, stored inside the file:</p>" + as_json(json.loads(identity)) + body
    return leaf(path.name, what, f"{n(len(frame), 'row')} × {n(frame.shape[1], 'column')}", body)


def analysis_tree() -> str:
    says = table_spec["descriptions"]
    of_table = {t["name"]: t["description"] for t in table_spec["tables"]}
    children = [leaf("analysis.json", says["analysis.json"], "", as_json(json.loads((ANALYSIS / "analysis.json").read_text())))]
    for stage in table_spec["stages"]:
        folder = ANALYSIS / stage
        if not folder.is_dir():
            continue
        inside = [table_leaf(folder / f"{name.split('/')[1]}.parquet", what)
                  for name, what in of_table.items() if name.startswith(f"{stage}/") and (folder / f"{name.split('/')[1]}.parquet").exists()]
        inside.append(leaf("record.json", says["record.json"], "", as_json(json.loads((folder / "record.json").read_text()))))
        children.append(branch(f"{stage}/", says["stages"][stage], "", inside))
    fits = ANALYSIS / table_spec["fits"]["folder"]
    if fits.is_dir():
        children.append(branch(f"{table_spec['fits']['folder']}/", says["fits"], "", [table_leaf(p, says["part"]) for p in sorted(fits.glob("*.parquet"))]))
    return f"<ul class='tree'>{branch(f'{ANALYSIS.name}/', says['analysis'], kilobytes(ANALYSIS), children)}</ul>"
```

```{=html}
<style>
ul.tree, ul.tree ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding-left: 0; }
ul.tree ul { margin-left: 0.6em; padding-left: 1em; border-left: 1px solid rgba(120, 130, 150, 0.45); }
ul.tree li { margin: 0.15em 0; }
ul.tree summary, ul.tree .branch { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 0.8em; align-items: baseline; padding: 0.15em 0.3em; border-radius: 4px; }
ul.tree summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; }
ul.tree summary:hover { background: rgba(120, 130, 150, 0.15); }
ul.tree summary::before { content: "▸"; width: 0.6em; opacity: 0.6; }
ul.tree details[open] > summary::before { content: "▾"; }
ul.tree .branch::before { content: ""; width: 0.6em; }
ul.tree summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
ul.tree code { font-weight: 600; background: none; padding: 0; color: inherit; }
ul.tree .what { flex: 1 1 16em; }
ul.tree .size { opacity: 0.65; font-size: 0.9em; white-space: nowrap; }
ul.tree .body { margin: 0.3em 0 0.8em 1.6em; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 0.85em; }
ul.tree .body pre { margin: 0; padding: 0.6em; }
ul.tree table.rows { width: auto; margin: 0.2em 0; border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
ul.tree table.rows th, ul.tree table.rows td { padding: 0.15em 0.7em; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(120, 130, 150, 0.3); white-space: nowrap; }
ul.tree .more, ul.tree ul.columns { margin: 0.2em 0; opacity: 0.8; }
ul.tree ul.columns { border: none; padding-left: 1.2em; list-style: disc; }
ul.tree ul.columns code { font-weight: 400; }
</style>
```

## The data file

A standard MuData `.h5mu` file. It holds raw counts and what is known about
the cells and the gRNAs, and nothing that an analysis computes.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(screen_tree())
```

## An analysis

A folder with one subfolder per completed stage. Tables are Parquet files, and
every row names cells, gRNAs and responses by identifier. This data file has
six analyses in `example/highmoi/analyses/`; this is `left_sided`.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(analysis_tree())
```

## Open it yourself

Standard libraries read both. Nothing here is specific to sceptre.

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```{r}
screen <- MuData::readH5MU("example/highmoi/screen.h5mu")
screen
```

```{r}
results <- nanoparquet::read_parquet("example/highmoi/analyses/left_sided/discovery/results.parquet")
head(results, 3)
```

## Python

```{python}
import mudata

screen = mudata.read_h5mu("example/highmoi/screen.h5mu")
print(screen)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

results = pd.read_parquet("example/highmoi/analyses/left_sided/discovery/results.parquet")
print(results.head(3))
```

:::

The checks that the format works, in both languages, are in `verify/`.
